schemaVersion.description: Version of the schema for migration purposes.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this star.

position.description: The 3D position of the star in the lifemap.

type.description: The type of star (e.g., memory, milestone).

intensity.description: The brightness or intensity of the star.

emotionScore.description: A score representing the emotion associated with the star.

year.description: The year the event represented by the star occurred.

archetype.description: The archetype associated with the star.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the star was created.
